meta.title: James Dickey / Deliverance — craft knowledge base
meta.disclaimer: Educational craft analysis only. Do not reproduce copyrighted passages at length. Paraphrase principles; quote minimally with attribution.

writers_toolbox.metaphor: River-body-image: prose as current — pressure, depth, snag, release.

shelves.name: Bottom Shelf (Foundation)
points: Kinetic verbs; concrete nouns that survive stress.
Syntax that carries motion: clause rhythm mimics water, portage, exhaustion.
Avoid decorative latinate pile-up when plain muscle reads truer.

shelves.name: Second Shelf (Style)
points: Compression: one image that does two jobs (place + dread).
Metaphor earned by physical context, not imported 'literary' gloss.
First-person filtration: what Ed notices, avoids, misreads — voice is cognition under strain.

shelves.name: Third Shelf (Scene Craft)
points: Situation-born dread: wilderness and social order exert force before 'horror' is named.
Group dynamics: competence, shame, pecking order — who leads, who lies, who pays.
Violence as sequence: impact, disorientation, then consequence (legal, moral, somatic).

shelves.name: Top Shelf (Theme & Resonance)
points: Class and masculinity surface through gear, language, body, risk — not thesis.
Civilization vs. wild: let the river and forest **argue** in sensory detail.
Complicity and survival guilt: the story continues in the body after the event.

core_philosophy: Story lives in **embodied situation**: what the river does to time, sound, and judgment.
Dread is often **delay + wrong confidence**: craft tests what characters assume is still true.
The moral question is staged as **choice under pressure**, not as a speech.
Aftermath is not epilogue — it is **identity maintenance** under new facts.
Landscape is psychology: weather, sound, fatigue rewrite what characters can afford to feel.

narrator_consciousness: Track what the narrator sees first vs. what he narrates later — gaps are dramatic.
Understatement after intensity: the voice tightens when memory protects itself.
structure_pressure: Journey + ordeal: each leg of the trip should change what 'home' means.
The hunt as moral machine: pursuit reframes who is predator, who is prey, who is witness.
sensory_channels: Sound: echo, snap, rush — acoustic space defines panic and control.
River as timekeeper: current speeds or stalls scenes more reliably than clock time.
Touch and weight: boats, rope, skin, mud — material truth grounds lyric flights.
aftermath_craft: Shame and cover-up scenes need **specific behaviors** (what hands do, what eyes avoid).
Survival's cost: relationships re-sort; humor dies where trust used to live.

signal: Earned fragmentation in dialogue under stress
Clear spatial staging — reader always knows where hurt can happen
noise: Abstract dread labels ('a sense of foreboding') without image
Moralizing narrator commentary that replaces sensation

hard_rules: Record sensation before interpretation in high-tension beats.
One dominant image per sentence in crisis; let the next sentence advance, not decorate.
Dialogue under pressure: interrupt, miss, deflect — avoid courtroom clarity.
Class: show through objects, jobs, bodies — not authorial judgment.
Violence: chronological clarity + bodily specificity; avoid slo-mo fetish and aestheticizing harm without cost.
Aftermath: track guilt as behavior (sleep, appetite, silence, avoidance).
Revision pass: cut any sentence that explains fear the image already shows.
Read aloud: where breath breaks, consider a cut or a period.
quotes_note: Add 3–8 short verified quotations from your own copies (interviews, essays, editions). Keep each under 25 words with precise attribution. Omit this array's emptiness in user-facing output unless asked.

mode_hints.create: Expand seeds into predicament: stakes, geography, group roles, what could go wrong first.
mode_hints.transform: Target one passage: improve image flow, cut abstraction, sharpen dialogue rhythm.
mode_hints.edit: Full pass: pacing of dread, aftermath integrity, narrator consistency, thematic emergence vs. sermon.

liberty_hints.nice: Honest but protective delivery; lead with what works; end with 2–3 concrete upgrades.
liberty_hints.neutral: Balanced diagnosis; equal weight to what works and what fails; direct fixes.
liberty_hints.professional: Numerical honesty if requested; failure taxonomy; ordered revision plan; no comfort padding.
